what: When a section title built from SVG text reaches 70% of the screen (once), only the outline is drawn in light gray over .7s with the inside left empty, then over .7s the outline and fill fill up with the text color (power2.out). As the fill starts, the text and buttons of the same section come in together over .7s, either from transparent (fade) or from 24px below (up) — if the text is not SVG, the title itself comes in with fade.

options.text · [data-fx-part=glyph]: SVG text for outline and fill (inside the title)
options.scope: Section to find fade·up in (CSS selector, ancestor of the heading) — if empty, only inside the heading
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: What comes in from transparent along with the fill (inside scope)
options.[data-fx-part=up]: Rises 24px from below along with the fill (inside scope)
options.dur: One-way length of outline and fill (sec), default .7
options.--fx-stroke-start: Initial outline color, default text color at 35% — light gray on dark panels

use: Body text

from.where: All section titles (original data-section-fade-trigger — SVG text·g[stroke] go transparent → #b0b0b0 .7s → #151515 fill .7s, data-section-fade·data-section-fade-up at contentFadeStart for .7s, top 70% once)
